scope: Time-series anomaly detection; existing imputation results are excluded

dataset_sources.path_resolution: Resolve registered assets through configs and manifests; exact author subset and derived AD split require a new frozen data manifest

requires: Author dataset and feature selection recorded
Model callable or explicit pending status
Environment lock, original commit, patch diff and score artifact hashes

author_specific_constraints: CrossAD MSL/SMAP single first continuous feature gets a separate track from full multivariate input
UCR subset membership must match each paper
GECCO/SWAN have incompatible local versions; match author version first
NASA and SMD entity boundaries must be recovered before windowing
Industrial imputation windows cannot serve as an AD split

tracks.purpose: Match each original paper independently before comparing algorithms
rules: Keep original threshold, PA and feature/subset decisions in separately named columns
Pin published architecture/backbone and checkpoint selection
Fix runtime bugs only with a logged minimal patch; semantic corrections are separate runs
Report mean, uncertainty and deviation from the matching paper row; do not demand every random seed match exactly

tracks.adjust_f_score: Optional author diagnostic; excluded from primary comparisons
tracks.boundary: TAB paper reports best outcomes over a ratio grid; current TSLib adapter pools train/test scores. Preserve and disclose transductive score calibration and test-label metric selection. TAB implementation also offers PA columns. User's exact TAB config/column remains unconfirmed.
freeze: Nonoverlap window and complete test coverage

tracks.threshold_rule: Validation score percentile; thresholds frozen before test; record normal-only or contaminated validation population
rules: No test scores or labels in calibration/model selection
One finite aligned score per test timestamp
Never flatten overlapping windows as separate timestamps
Online causal and offline future-context methods reported separately
TEP group by operating mode, simulation run and fault ID
SKAB group by experiment and failure episode
PRONTO group by day and operating/fault episode
Freeze fault-to-anomaly mapping and temporal/group held-out splits
Refit preprocessing on target training only; no automatic reuse of imputation masks

preprocessing: Train-fit scaler; never fit on test
Train-only imputation parameters with explicit PSM missing-value rule
Drop timestamp from model features unless author protocol explicitly retains it
Preserve channels/entity IDs and anomaly-event boundaries
reproducibility.uncertainty: Report seed mean/std and 95% paired confidence intervals with entity/run or temporal-block resampling; no IID timestamp bootstrap
fairness: Report parameters, training time, score inference time and memory
MOMENT zero-shot, linear probe and fine-tuning are separate; audit checkpoint availability and pretraining dataset overlap

fm_candidates.status: No completed formal anomaly-detection runs; library objective classes are not trained anomaly detectors
adaptation_candidates: GRASP spectral/graph velocity discrepancy with explicit reconstruction status
Conditional masked prediction residual with the scored target hidden from condition
Velocity discrepancy with a defined normal reference
Actual CNF likelihood only if ODE divergence and base density are evaluated
fm_candidates.score_selection: Freeze score and all aggregation rules using validation; likelihood proxies must not be labelled exact likelihood

diagnostic_sequence.test: Same saved scores under author, TAB and strict protocols
diagnostic_sequence.interpretation: Separates PA, test-label threshold optimization, pooled score calibration, VUS buffer and window aggregation

diagnostic_sequence.test: Raw-score AUROC/AP and diagnostic oracle F1 ceiling
diagnostic_sequence.interpretation: Good ranking with low fixed-threshold F1 suggests calibration mismatch; poor ranking suggests model/score failure. Oracle is diagnostic only.

diagnostic_sequence.test: Audit split, channels, coverage, preprocessing, checkpoints and numerical stability
diagnostic_sequence.interpretation: Distinguishes reproduction mismatch from methodological weakness
Separate scoring objective, representation, optimization and compute effects

diagnostic_sequence.test: Held-out fault types, operating modes, drift and contamination
diagnostic_sequence.interpretation: Measure normal-distribution fit versus useful abnormal separation; accept inferior results rather than tune on test

others: Point versus contextual versus collective/fault anomalies
prospective_robustness_axes.budget_rule: Predeclare a tractable one-factor ablation schedule after validation pilot; this is not a full Cartesian job queue
